english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for belief in your own abilities, especially when discussing someone’s level of self-confidence.

examples.english: Her self-confidence is strong, and she is not nervous speaking on stage at all.
examples.traditional: 佢嘅自信心好強，喺台上講嘢一啲都唔怯。
